title: Wakeville High School Bell Sound Contest
fullPassage: Wakeville High School is holding a school bell sound contest. The theme of this contest is Happy School Life. Deadline: December 12, 2025. Participants: Wakeville High School students of all grades. Application Details: Submit entries in MP3 format only. Upload entries to our school website (file size limit: 1MB). Include the description of the sound creation process. Selection Method: Three school bell sounds will be selected by student vote, based on creativity and suitability. Awards: The winning school bell sounds will replace our current bell sounds. The winners of the contest will each get a wireless speaker.
